name: std: kernel loads and an assembly opens
eval: window.__mymechanics.actions.ensureKernel().then(() => window.__mymechanics.actions.newDocument('assembly')).then(() => window.__mymechanics.state.doc ? 'ok' : 'no doc')

name: std: the Library · Routing tab lists its commands (as buttons or in its flyouts)
eval: (() => { const tab = document.querySelector('[data-cm-tab="stdTools"]'); if (!tab) return 'no tab'; tab.click(); return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r(['stdLibrary', 'smartFastener', 'pipeRoute', 'tubeRoute', 'cableRoute', 'harnessRoute'].filter((id) => document.querySelector(`#palette-host [data-command="${id}"], #palette-host [data-fly-items~="${id}"]`)).length), 200)); })()

name: std: the library opens with 7 categories and a size table
eval: window.__mymechanics.run('stdLibrary').then(() => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify({ mode: window.__mymechanics.state.editing?.mode, cats: document.querySelectorAll('.std-cat').length, rows: document.querySelectorAll('.std-table tr[data-pm-set]').length })), 200)))

name: std: clicking fittings → flange → DN25 row → Insert puts a flange in the assembly
eval: (async () => { const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); q('[data-pm-set="stdCategory"][data-value="fittings"]').click(); await wait(100); q('[data-pm-set="stdKind"][data-value="flange"]').click(); await wait(100); q('.std-table tr[data-pm-set][data-value="DN25"]').click(); await wait(100); await window.__mymechanics.pmCommand?.('std.insert'); if (!document.querySelector('[data-pm="std.insert"]')) return 'no insert button'; return 'ok'; })()

(async () => { if (window.__mymechanics.project.assemblies[0].components.length === 0) document.querySelector('[data-pm="std.insert"]').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600)); const a = window.__mymechanics.project.assemblies[0]; return JSON.stringify({ comps: a.components.length, parts: window.__mymechanics.project.parts.map((p) => p.name) }); })()
name: std: the flange component and its part
std: an M8 hex bolt inserted twice is one part, two components
eval: (async () => { const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); q('[data-pm-set="stdCategory"][data-value="bolts"]').click(); await wait(100); q('[data-pm-set="stdKind"][data-value="hexBolt"]').click(); await wait(100); q('.std-table tr[data-pm-set][data-value="M8"]').click(); await wait(100); q('[data-pm="std.insert"]').click(); await wait(500); q('[data-pm="std.insert"]').click(); await wait(500); const pr = window.__mymechanics.project; return JSON.stringify({ comps: pr.assemblies[0].components.length, bolts: pr.parts.filter((p) => /ISO 4017 M8/.test(p.name)).length }); })()

name: std: a 6204 bearing from the bearings category
eval: (async () => { const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); q('[data-pm-set="stdCategory"][data-value="bearings"]').click(); await wait(100); q('.std-table tr[data-pm-set][data-value="6204"]').click(); await wait(100); q('[data-pm="std.insert"]').click(); await wait(600); document.querySelector('[data-pm="ok"]').click(); await wait(300); return JSON.stringify({ mode: window.__mymechanics.state.editing?.mode ?? null, names: window.__mymechanics.project.parts.map((p) => p.name).join('|') }); })()

name: std: the gears category lists helical, bevel, rack and pulley; a helical gear (β 15°) inserts with its figures
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.run('stdLibrary'); await wait(200); q('[data-pm-set="stdCategory"][data-value="gears"]').click(); await wait(150); const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-pm-set="stdKind"]')].map((b) => b.dataset.value).join(','); q('[data-pm-set="stdKind"][data-value="helicalGear"]').click(); await wait(150); const info = q('.std-info')?.textContent ?? ''; q('[data-pm="std.insert"]').click(); await wait(2500); q('[data-pm="ok"]')?.click(); await wait(200); return JSON.stringify({ items, info: info.length > 10, gear: m.project.parts.some((p) => /mn2 z24/.test(p.name)) }); })()

name: std: removing the bolts leaves the flange for the fastener test
eval: (() => { const m = window.__mymechanics; m.actions.change('op.edit', (pr) => { const a = pr.assemblies[0]; a.components = a.components.filter((c) => /DN25/.test(c.name)); }); return m.project.assemblies[0].components.length; })()

name: std: smart fastener on a flange bolt hole → M12 bolts, washers and nuts in all 4 holes of the pattern, 9 mates each (spin locked) that hold
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.run('smartFastener'); const a = m.project.assemblies[0]; const c = a.components[0]; const part = m.project.parts.find((p) => p.id === c.part); const b = m.actions.buildPart(part); const index = b.faces.findIndex((f) => (f.geomType === 'CYLINDRE' || f.geomType === 'CYLINDER') && Math.hypot(f.center.x, f.center.y) > 30); const r = await m.std.fastenerPick({ kind: 'face', bodyKey: `comp:${c.id}`, index }); return JSON.stringify({ bolt: r?.plan?.bolt, comps: a.components.length, mates: a.mates.length, failed: m.state.failedMates.size }); })()

name: std: the bolt sits on the hole axis
eval: (() => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const a = m.project.assemblies[0]; const bolt = a.components.find((c) => /ISO 4017 M12/.test(c.name)); const nut = a.components.find((c) => /ISO 4032/.test(c.name)); const r = Math.hypot(bolt.position[0], bolt.position[1]); return JSON.stringify({ r: Math.round(r * 100) / 100, sameAxis: Math.hypot(bolt.position[0] - nut.position[0], bolt.position[1] - nut.position[1]) < 1e-3 }); })()

name: std: a fastener changed after inserting (M10 × 50) is made again on the same hole, its mates hold
eval: (() => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const a = m.project.assemblies[0]; const g = a.fasteners[0]; m.std.editFastener(g.id, { size: 'M10', length: 50 }); const f = a.fasteners[0]; return JSON.stringify({ name: f.name, groups: a.fasteners.length, comps: a.components.length, failed: m.state.failedMates.size }); })()

name: std: a hole series through two stacked washers — one bolt through both (grip 3.2), the nut under the lower one
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const a = m.project.assemblies[0]; const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.run('stdLibrary'); await wait(150); const e = m.state.editing; Object.assign(e.p, { kind: 'flatWasher', size: 'M8' }); const w1 = await m.std.insertLibrary(); const w2 = await m.std.insertLibrary(); m.actions.change('op.edit', () => { for (const [c, z] of [[w1, 0], [w2, 1.6]]) { const x = a.components.find((k) => k.id === c.id); x.position = [300, 0, z]; x.fixed = true; } }); await wait(300); await m.run('smartFastener'); await wait(150); const top = a.components.find((k) => k.id === w2.id); const part = m.project.parts.find((p) => p.id === top.part); const b = m.actions.buildPart(part); const index = b.faces.findIndex((f) => { if (f.geomType !== 'CYLINDRE' && f.geomType !== 'CYLINDER') return false; const q = f.pointOnSurface(0.5, 0.5); return Math.abs(Math.hypot(q.x, q.y) - 4.2) < 1e-3; }); const before = a.components.length; const r = await m.std.fastenerPick({ kind: 'face', bodyKey: `comp:${top.id}`, index }); const g = a.fasteners.at(-1); return JSON.stringify({ added: a.components.length - before, grip: Math.round((r?.plan?.grip ?? 0) * 100) / 100, parts: g?.spec?.parts?.length, nut: Boolean(r?.plan?.nut), stacked: m.state.editing?.last?.stacked, failed: m.state.failedMates.size }); })()
(() => { window.__mymechanics.run('zoomFit'); return 'ok'; })()

name: route: a pipe route in the assembly takes clicked points
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; if (m.state.editing) m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); await m.run('pipeRoute'); const vp = m.viewport; const r = vp.canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); window.__pt = [r.left + r.width * 0.15, r.top + r.height * 0.8]; return m.state.editing?.mode; })()

name: route: the clicks added points
eval: window.__mymechanics.state.editing.f.points.length

name: route: typed points give a pipe with elbows, a BOM and the route length
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const e = m.state.editing; e.f.points = [[200, 0, 0], [200, 0, 200], [400, 0, 200], [400, 200, 200]]; e.f.dn = 'DN25'; e.f.fittings = 'elbows'; e.f.flanges = 'start'; m.actions.pmSet('kind', 'pipe'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.route-bom tr')].slice(1).map((tr) => tr.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')); return JSON.stringify({ rows, length: document.querySelector('[data-route-length]')?.dataset.routeLength }); })()

name: route: OK adds the route part at the origin
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const a = m.project.assemblies[0]; const rc = a.components.at(-1); const rp = m.project.parts.find((p) => p.id === rc.part); const res = m.actions.buildPart(rp).result.results.get(rp.features[0].id); return JSON.stringify({ comps: a.components.length, fixed: rc.fixed, ok: res.ok, length: Math.round(res.route.length), elbows: res.route.bom.rows.filter((x) => x.item === 'elbow').map((x) => x.qty) }); })()
(() => { window.__mymechanics.run('zoomFit'); return 'ok'; })()

name: route: a cable route feature in a part shows its BOM and builds
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.run('newPart'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); await m.run('cableRoute'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const e = m.state.editing; const bom = document.querySelector('.route-bom') ? 'bom' : 'no bom'; await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const part = m.active(); const f = part.features.find((x) => x.type === 'route'); const res = m.actions.buildPart(part).result.results.get(f.id); return JSON.stringify({ type: e.feature?.type, bom, ok: res.ok, cable: res.route.bom.rows[0].item, len: Math.round(res.route.length) }); })()

name: route: a pipe branch from the PM gets an automatic tee in the BOM
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.run('pipeRoute'); await wait(400); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('bendRadius', '20', 'length'); await wait(300); document.querySelector('[data-pm="routeEdit:addBranch"]').click(); await wait(600); const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.route-bom tr')].slice(1).map((tr) => tr.children[0].textContent.trim()); const f = m.state.editing.feature; await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await wait(400); const part = m.active(); const res = m.actions.buildPart(part).result.results.get(f.id); return JSON.stringify({ branches: f.branches.length, ok: res.ok, tees: res.route.bom.fittings.tees, rows: items.length }); })()

name: route: an electrical harness shows connectors, wires, the wire list and the flattened drawing
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.run('harnessRoute'); await wait(600); const q = (s) => document.querySelectorAll(s).length; const before = { conns: q('.harness-row.conn:not(.head)'), wires: q('.harness-row.wire'), list: q('[data-wire-length]'), flat: q('.harness-flat svg line[data-length]') }; document.querySelector('[data-pm="routeEdit:addWire"]').click(); await wait(600); const f = m.state.editing.feature; await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await wait(400); const part = m.active(); const res = m.actions.buildPart(part).result.results.get(f.id); return JSON.stringify({ ...before, ok: res.ok, kind: res.route.bom.kind, wiresAfter: res.route.bom.wires.length, colours: res.route.colors.length }); })()

name: route: Harness Drawing puts the flattened harness and its tables on a new drawing sheet
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const part = m.active(); const partId = part.id; await m.run('harnessDrawing'); await wait(900); const d = m.project.drawings.at(-1); const kinds = d.annotations.map((a) => a.kind); const st = () => document.querySelector('[data-harness-status]')?.dataset.harnessStatus ?? 'none'; const out = { kind: m.project.active?.kind ?? '', harness: kinds.filter((k) => k === 'drwHarness').length, tables: kinds.filter((k) => k === 'drwTable').length, drawn: document.querySelectorAll('#drawing-host .dx-drwHarness').length, page: m.state.editing?.mode, status: st() }; m.actions.pmToggle('hsAuto', false); await wait(300); m.actions.change('op.edit', (pr) => { const f = pr.parts.find((x) => x.id === partId).features.find((x) => x.type === 'route' && x.kind === 'harness'); f.wires[0].gauge = 1.5; }); await wait(500); out.after = st(); document.querySelector('[data-pm="std.harnessUpdate"]')?.click(); await wait(600); out.updated = st(); out.gauge = d.annotations.find((a) => a.role === 'wires')?.cells[1][4]; m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); await m.actions.switchDocument({ kind: 'part', id: partId }); await wait(500); return JSON.stringify(out); })()

name: std: a socket head cap screw as a body of the part (library in part mode)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.run('stdLibrary'); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); q('[data-pm-set="stdKind"][data-value="socketCap"]').click(); await wait(100); const placement = Boolean(q('[data-pm-field="x"]')); q('[data-pm="std.insert"]').click(); await wait(500); m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); const part = m.active(); const f = part.features.find((x) => x.type === 'stdPart'); const res = m.actions.buildPart(part).result.results.get(f.id); return JSON.stringify({ placement, ok: res.ok, kind: f.kind, tree: [...document.querySelectorAll('.tree-row .tree-label')].some((e) => /StdPart|표준부품/.test(e.textContent)) }); })()

name: std: editing the standard part feature changes its size from the PM
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const part = m.active(); const f = part.features.find((x) => x.type === 'stdPart'); m.actions.editFeature(f.id); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const sel = document.querySelector('[data-pm-select="stdSize"]'); sel.value = 'M12'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const ed = m.state.editing.feature; await m.actions.acceptEditing(); return JSON.stringify({ size: ed.size, length: ed.length, saved: part.features.find((x) => x.type === 'stdPart').size }); })()
(() => { window.__mymechanics.run('zoomFit'); return 'ok'; })()

name: render: the render mode draws a picture progressively (path tracer, small picture)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.switchDocument?.({ kind: 'assembly', id: m.project.assemblies[0].id }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600)); Object.assign(m.std.renderSettings, { mode: 'final', samples: 8, resolution: 'small', env: 'studio', ground: 'shadow' }); await m.run('renderView'); return m.state.editing?.mode + ' ' + Boolean(document.querySelector('.render-view canvas')); })()

name: render: the picture has content (brightness and contrast) at 640×360
eval: JSON.stringify(window.__mymechanics.std.photo.stats(), (k, v) => (typeof v === 'number' ? Math.round(v) : v))
(() => { const s = window.__mymechanics.std.photo.stats(); if (!(s.mean > 40 && s.mean < 250 && s.std > 5)) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(s)); return 'ok'; })()
name: render: not blank
render: sunset, floor and depth of field re-render from the PM
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; m.std.renderSettings.samples = 6; m.actions.pmSet('env', 'sunset'); m.actions.pmSet('ground', 'floor'); m.actions.pmToggle('dof', true); return m.std.renderSettings.env + ' ' + m.std.renderSettings.dof; })()

name: render: Save image hands a PNG to the save path (test hook, no dialog)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; let got = null; m.std.setSaveHook((blob, name) => { got = { size: blob.size, type: blob.type, name }; }); document.querySelector('[data-pm="std.renderSave"]').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800)); m.std.setSaveHook(null); return JSON.stringify(got); })()

name: render: closing the mode removes the picture
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; Object.assign(m.std.renderSettings, { env: 'studio', ground: 'shadow', dof: false }); await m.run('renderView'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); return `${m.state.editing?.mode ?? 'none'} ${document.querySelectorAll('.render-view').length}`; })()
